content: Canvas/WebGL graphs have no per-node a11y tree. Required: figure+summary, table/tree equivalent, one-tab-stop keyboard traversal with visible focus, role=status for filters, do not aria-hidden the only representation. Proxy-per-node is impractical at 47k; traverse LOD groups + searchable table. WCAG 1.1.1, 2.1.1, 2.1.2, 2.4.7, 4.1.3.
